verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a one-line docs mention of a first-party Mission Control Agent for investigating the customer's environment and making supported changes. That plausibly delivers AI-generated analysis of the user's own infrastructure inside the product, but its depth is undocumented. Billing insights and Grafana dashboards are conventional reporting, not AI-generated, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights or suggestions the agent produces and from which data (telemetry, logs, usage, cost), how it surfaces them in the Cloud Console, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
